name: Factual trust cues
rule: Earn trust with specific, verifiable facts and real controls, not decorative badges or vague reassurance.

leaders.note: States the actual fee basis, the rate source and a discount threshold. It names what drives cost and links a calculator for exact figures.
Lists named attestations and certifications with scope, a certificate link and a trust center, plus concrete encryption, backup and failover details.
Backs security with controls users can act on: scoped keys, access policies, rotation with a grace period, and request logs per key.
